description: Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης. Coverage: Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Θέσεις Στάθμευσης ΑΜΕΑ; Χώρος Στάθμευσης Προξενείων; Χώροι Στάθμευσης; Αρχείο Γεωγραφικής Απόδοσης (σημειακά δεδομένα) των θέσεων των χώρων σ. Formats seen: CSV, KML, WMS, GEOJSON, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
